red.cliStatus: Before this change the optimization handoff did not print source/capture state, phase, or package-local validation scope; the ordinary non-optimize path also completed a timed-out source session with exit code 0.
red.redCommand: bun test ./test/cli/run-failure-exit.test.ts (new status assertions failed before the CLI change)
red.preservedSourceFailures: OptimizationSession already blocks a non-ok source from optimization; no source replay or failure relabeling was introduced.

coverage.naturalClosure: Existing continuous-production-closure runs a natural task with a real temporary work directory through source capture, Evidence/workspace, candidate program, one metadata-only repair, validation, package export and same-package original/changed consumption.
validationCompletion: No validation declaration with complete observed input/output/entry is deterministically auto-wired.
An empty declaration with an observed model-only parameter remains repairable and retains the original action until one bounded repair adopts it.
Missing output or semantic authority remains unresolved; no oracle is invented.
statusSeparation: Source timeout and adapter failure are rendered separately from capture status.
No-change is rendered as a terminal optimization state without a package.
Completed packages report action-local program validation scope and run counts; partial/not-run status is not promoted to a full recommendation.
Ordinary non-optimize source timeout now persists a failed run session and returns exit code 1.
coverage.claimBoundary: F8 proves default-chain wiring and failure-state reporting with deterministic local doubles. It does not count simulated providers as real model optimization success and does not establish whole-skill correctness, effect, readiness, prospective, held-out or human-savings claims.
